Blume Capital Management Inc increased its stake in Schlumberger (SLB) by 5.52% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 106,561 shares of the oilfield services and equipment company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $7.43M, up from 100,991 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Blume Capital Management Inc who had been investing in Schlumberger for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $90.92 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.40% or $0.93 during the last trading session, reaching $65.7. About 2.78M shares traded. Schlumberger Limited (NYSE:SLB) has declined 3.30% since March 7, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.00% the S&P500.
